heroImage.alt: A CSS selector learning game showing animal elements on plates, HTML markup and a code editor for writing selectors to match specific elements

data.fullDescription: RSS CSS Selectors — a trainer for learning CSS selectors, inspired by CSS Diner. Every level shows a bit of markup with some elements pulsing, and you write a selector that matches exactly those. Hover the code or the picture to see what matches what, hit Help if you're stuck, and your progress is saved between visits.
